'''Christian García González''' (born 4 February 1999) is an Andorran [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Defender (association football)#Centre-back|centre-back]] for [[Atlètic Club d'Escaldes]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].<ref>{{WorldFootball.net}}</ref>

==Career==
García made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] on 17 November 2020 in the [[2020–21 UEFA Nations League D|UEFA Nations League]] against [[Latvia national football team|Latvia]], being sent off with a second yellow card in the closing moments of the match.<ref name="EUF">{{cite web |url=https://eu-football.info/_player.php?id=31282 |title=Christian García |website=EU-Football.info |access-date=17 November 2020}}</ref>
